hero_slides.title: Developing Future Leaders
hero_slides.text: We equip young people with essential leadership skills, confidence, and vision to become transformational leaders in their communities.

hero_slides.title: Transformative Mentorship
hero_slides.text: Connecting youth with experienced mentors who provide guidance, support, and career advice to help them reach their full potential.

hero_slides.title: Youth Advocacy & Voice
hero_slides.text: Empowering young people to become advocates for issues they care about and driving positive change in their communities.

hero_slides.title: Community Transformation
hero_slides.text: Creating lasting impact through youth-led community projects, volunteering, and initiatives that address local challenges.

about_text_1: Mary Gold is a non-profit organization dedicated to empowering young people through mentorship, leadership development, and advocacy. We believe every young person has potential, and with the right guidance and support, they can become transformational leaders.
about_text_2: Founded in 2015, we have impacted over 10,000 youth across the country, helping them develop the skills, confidence, and mindset needed to succeed in life.
programs_subtitle: Comprehensive initiatives designed to transform youth potential into achievement
